title: Executive daily priorities - Raphael - 2026-03-12
content:
Top priorities (today) - Thu 2026-03-12:

1) Finalize Dedicated launch readiness checklist (GO/NO-GO)
   - Confirm infra + SRE runbook: Maya to confirm autoscale smoke test results by 11:00 PT.
   - Open action: Elena to review billing/commit language for reserved capacity contract (redlines expected).
   - Risk: last-minute kernel regression on Ampere nodes - if perf delta >5% need rollback plan.

2) Customer briefing prep: Acme Health (CISO) - 1:30 PM
   - Goal: reassure on Private deployment network isolation + KMS integration timeline (June GA).
   - Bring: high-level architecture slide, timeline, escalation contact (Cameron).
   - Prep notes: emphasize audit logs, HSM option; avoid committing specific dates beyond Q2.

3) Exec leadership sync (standup) + decisions on headcount allocation for 2H hiring
   - Need to decide: allocate +3 infra vs +3 applied-ml? Proposal: +2 infra, +1 applied-ml.
   - Financial constraint: stick within FY commit; finance to provide midpoint forecast by EOD.

Calendar highlights / immediate meetings:
- 09:00 - Leadership standup (30m) - runbook status, top escalations.
- 10:15 - Ops deep-dive (Maya + SRE) - autoscale test results.
- 11:30 - Product sync (30m) - Optimize toolkit rollout PRD review.
- 13:30 - Customer: Acme Health CISO briefing (prep attached).
- 15:00 - FP&A headcount review (decision needed)

Meeting prep quick bullets:
- Leadership standup: bring 2-line status for each major initiative. For Dedicated launch: readiness = amber (autoscale smoke + contract wording outstanding).
- Ops deep-dive: ask for quantized perf numbers across regions; have a short checklist of fallbacks (fallback model variant, region shift).
- Product sync: be explicit about rollout guardrails for Optimize suggestions (opt-in, canary % thresholds).

Follow-ups & action items (to track):
- Maya: autoscale smoke test logs + perf summary (due 2026-03-12 12:00).
- Elena: contract redlines for reserved capacity (due 2026-03-12 14:00).
- Cameron: customer escalation sheet + backup presenter (due 2026-03-12 12:30).
- Finance (Liam): updated headcount budget midpoint (due 2026-03-12 EOD).
- Product (Anika): finalize Optimize PRD section on quantization recommendations (due 2026-03-13).

Notes to self / rough thoughts:
- Consider explicit SLA language for Dedicated: include latency percentile guarantees with credits (keeps sales negotiating position clear).
- If Acme pushes for on-prem install earlier than planned, push back: offer Private pilot (VPC) + dev-only on-prem proved plan for later.
- Hiring trade-off: infra hires can reduce ops toil and accelerate Dedicated GA; applied-ml hires accelerate model quality improvements that reduce unit cost - both important; lean slightly toward infra for immediate GA risk mitigation.

Open questions / blockers:
- Kernel regression scope: is it a perf-only issue or correctness? (Maya to triage).
- Legal: any special language required for healthcare PHI in reserved capacity contracts? (Elena to confirm with Legal).
- Sales: do we have price guardrails for early committed customers who want deeper discounts? (Sales to propose).

Tactical TODOs (personal):
- 08:30: quick pass on slide deck (customer) - finalize two architecture slides.
- 12:45: rehearse customer talking points with Cameron.
- 16:30: review hiring trade-offs with People Ops (20m).
- EOD: update exec dashboard with readiness status + any blocker flags.

Style notes / rough copy snippets (for slide/customer email):
- "Redwood Private offers a single-tenant control plane with customer-managed network boundaries and optional HSM-backed key management - designed for HIPAA and regulated deployments."
- "We recommend a pilot deployment in your VPC to validate integration points; production on-prem agreement can follow once pilot metrics are validated."

Scratch:
- Possible quick wins before GA: increase KV-cache TTL on common prefixes -> ~10-15% token cost reduction in early tests (low risk).
- Follow up with SRE about enabling per-route tracing sampler at 1% for first 72h of Dedicated GA.

End-of-day success criteria:
- Autoscale tests validated or clear mitigation plan owned.
- Contract redlines in hand and legal call scheduled if needed.
- Customer briefing completed with no outstanding regulatory blockers.
- Headcount decision direction communicated to People Ops.

Misc quick links (for my reference):
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Dedicated+launch+runbook
- JIRA: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/DED-987
- Slack thread: #dedicated-launch (pin: message-ij3k4)

Notes to self: keep notes short in meeting, capture owners + due dates, escalate early if any 24h blockers.

-- Raphael
